description: This file defines a helper class 'LoanTransactionHelper' for testing and managing loan transactions within the Fineract API. It provides methods to perform operations such as creating, approving, disbursing, repaying loans, and handling related actions, mainly for integration testing purposes.

classes.name: LoanTransactionHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing methods for managing loan transactions, approvals, disbursals, repayments, and other related operations within Fineract for testing purposes.

methods.name: getLoanProduct
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific loan product by ID.

methods.name: listAllLoanProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all available loan products.

methods.name: getLoanProductId
methods.description: Creates a new loan product from JSON payload and returns its resource ID.

methods.name: approveLoan
methods.description: Approves a loan with a specified approval date.

methods.name: disburseLoan
methods.description: Disburses a loan with specified parameters such as date, amount, external ID, etc.

methods.name: performLoanTransaction
methods.description: Executes a loan transaction with specified command, URL, payload, and optional response validation.

methods.name: createInterestPauseByExternalId
methods.description: Creates an interest pause for a loan identified by external ID, posting the relevant transaction to the Fineract API.

methods.name: updateInterestPauseByLoanId
methods.description: Updates an interest pause for a loan by loan ID and term variation ID, posting the update transaction.

methods.name: updateInterestPauseByExternalId
methods.description: Updates an interest pause identified by external ID and term variation ID.

methods.name: deleteInterestPauseByLoanId
methods.description: Deletes an interest pause for a loan by loan ID and term variation ID.

methods.name: deleteInterestPauseByExternalId
methods.description: Deletes an interest pause for a loan via external ID.

methods.name: retrieveInterestPauseByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves interest pause details for a loan based on loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveInterestPauseByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves interest pause details via external ID.

methods.name: makeInterestPaymentWaiver
methods.description: Executes an interest payment waiver for a loan or external loan ID.

methods.name: reAge
methods.description: Performs a 're-age' transaction on a loan, possibly moving the repayment schedule.

methods.name: reAmortize
methods.description: Performs re-amortization of a loan schedule.

methods.name: undoReAge
methods.description: Reverses a re-age transaction on a loan.

methods.name: undoReAmortize
methods.description: Reverses an amortization.

methods.name: undoWaiveLoanCharge
methods.description: Undoes a waive charge transaction, accessible via different identifiers (Loan ID, external ID, transaction ID).

methods.name: waiveLoanCharge
methods.description: Waives a specific loan charge, identified by either loan ID and charge ID or external IDs.

methods.name: makeLoanRepayment
methods.description: Executes a repayment transaction on a loan, either by external ID or internal loan ID.

methods.name: makeMerchantIssuedRefund
methods.description: Processes a merchant-issued refund.

methods.name: makePayoutRefund
methods.description: Processes a payout refund.

methods.name: makeChargeRefund
methods.description: Processes a charge refund.

methods.name: manualInterestRefund
methods.description: Performs an interest refund on a loan, returning a response with the adjustment.

methods.name: makeGoodwillCredit
methods.description: Applies a goodwill credit to a loan.

methods.name: makeWaiveInterest
methods.description: Waives interest on a loan.

methods.name: makeWriteoff
methods.description: Writes off a loan.

methods.name: makeUndoWriteoff
methods.description: Reverses a previous write-off.

methods.name: makeRecoveryPayment
methods.description: Processes a recovery payment for a loan.

methods.name: makeRefundByCash
methods.description: Processes a cash refund towards a loan.

methods.name: makeCreditBalanceRefund
methods.description: Performs a credit balance refund.

methods.name: reverseLoanTransaction
methods.description: Reverses a loan transaction, identified either by external or internal IDs.

methods.name: chargebackLoanTransaction
methods.description: Charges back a specific loan transaction.

methods.name: adjustLoanTransaction
methods.description: Adjusts a loan transaction, supports different identifiers.

methods.name: getLoanTransactionDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details of a loan transaction, either by internal IDs or external IDs, with optional parameters.

methods.name: getLoanDetails
methods.description: Fetches comprehensive details for a loan, by ID or external ID.

methods.name: getLoanTransactions
methods.description: Lists transactions for a loan, with filtering options.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoans
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all loans with filtering by account number, associations, and client ID.

methods.name: addLoanCharge
methods.description: Adds a charge to a loan, by ID or external ID.

methods.name: addChargesForLoan
methods.description: Adds charges to an already disbursed loan.

methods.name: updateChargesForLoan
methods.description: Updates existing charges for a loan.

methods.name: updateLoanCharge
methods.description: Updates a specific loan charge, identified by ID or external ID.

methods.name: deleteLoanCharge
methods.description: Deletes a loan charge.

methods.name: chargeAdjustment
methods.description: Adjusts a loan charge, supporting different ID types.

methods.name: undoWaiveChargesForLoanReturnResourceId
methods.description: Undoes waiving of charges for a loan transaction by internal or external identifiers.

methods.name: payChargesForLoan
methods.description: Processes payment for a specific loan charge.

methods.name: payLoanCharge
methods.description: Pays a certain charge on a loan, by different ID formats.

methods.name: getLoanTransactionDetails
methods.description: Fetches detailed info of a specific transaction for a loan.
